# E0210: a minor version requires a field its predecessor does not declare

A minor version is backward compatible with its predecessor: every instance of
the predecessor is an instance of it. A new field that data must supply breaks
that, since no prior instance supplies it. Give the field a default, make it
optional, or make this a major version.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0210]: b in schema 0.1 is required in the new schema but not declared in the prior one
  --> lineage.cue:12:5
   |
12 |                 b: int
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule field-added-required)
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
